improvements: Refreshed the full irregular cathedral outline from OSM without reducing its apses and arm returns.
Ground collision follows the source polygon rather than strips through its recesses.

Applied the complete source-part profile pass: OSM52m nave envelope (48m eave plus4m pitched roof), exact mapped62.8m mansard base and71.8m lower drum source outlines; main drum97.8m retained and decorative crown remapped to127.05m source envelope. Exact western bell-body source polygon reaches78m.
remainingGaps: Independent engineering/project references distinguish127m interior-floor-to-cross from133m ground-to-cross; OSM has no elevation datum, so the renderer follows OSM127.05m pending source reconciliation.
Bell dome w1283287480 has height4 despite its elevated location: conflicting absolute-height scope is recorded, not silently interpreted as an absolute4m structure.
Several secondary white-body71m and dome72m/roof:height7m tags overlap incompatibly; their full detailed vertical profiles still require reconciliation.
Dome curvature, ribs, crosses and facade subdivisions remain estimates.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.
